title: EasyLinux Installer
install_hint: Click a profile to install it. The first internal disk will be erased completely.
done: Installation finished. The PC restarts in a few seconds.
err_download: The profiles could not be downloaded from GitHub. Check the network cable.
err_profiles: The profiles on GitHub contain errors.
err_need_gpu: This profile needs an {gpu} graphics card, but none was found.
err_need_gpu_any: This profile needs an NVIDIA or AMD graphics card, but none was found.
err_need_ram: This profile needs at least {need} GB of RAM; this PC has {have} GB.
err_no_disk: No internal disk of at least {gb} GB was found.
